answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sonnet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The falcon holds work receipts rather than names, so the vault of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
